== Summary ==
Slip “•I Don’t Need Their Scum, Either” cut unchanged from page 9 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF file created 10 August 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (590, 75, 1102, 360)). Version [[I Don't Need Their Scum, Either (V)]] (Original). Not a recreation.
